  PROBLEM: The last autofix run (commit cd55688) re-added `import shutil`, `import pytest`, the `_dir_runs_executables` helper and the autouse, module-scoped `_exec_capable_tempdir` fixture, which changes the global `tempfile.tempdir`. The file has nothing to do with issue #8360, and the change moves it away from merge-base blob 9c3ff07.
  WHY: The failing gate-poll tests (lines ~594-710) fail because of the poll/wait budgets (`PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_POLL_SECS=1`, `PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_WAIT_SECS`/`PROMOTE_CYCLE_GATE_IDLE_WAIT_SECS` of 3-6), not a noexec `/tmp`. Because the file now differs from the merge-base, the pre-push gate counts its 10 failing tests as "Failures caused by this change" and the gate fails. The fixture also changes a global and can leave the `promote-cycle-tests-*` directory in `~` behind. Severity: sonnet, minimax and glm said MAJOR; gemini gave none.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:542,7386-7400 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: According to these reviewers, `_CRASH_ERROR_PATH_RE` and the `candidate.startswith("scripts/")` check in `heal_scope_linked_workflow_paths` reject script paths written as `./scripts/...`, so those scripts are never added to the frozen heal scope.
  WHY: Release workflows call scripts as `./scripts/...` (e.g. `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4189` `bash ./scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh`). The linked-path extension would then add nothing for that step, and the heal would be refused as `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope`. Disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR and gemini gave no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked the regex and call this FALSE: the character before `scripts` in `./scripts/x.sh` is `/`, which is in the negated class, so `scripts/x.sh` is captured and passes the `startswith` check.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
